subject: general
question: Pole P is to the north of pole R. Pole Q is to the east of pole R and north of pole S. What is the position of pole R with respect to pole S?
solution:
Given: 

Pole P is to the north of pole R.

Pole Q is to the east of pole R and north of pole S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ed4bb4e433ab7d4befd1b930df224da88e15361cc2b43031fdb088e6e67e356.png] 

Thus, **North - west** is the position of pole R with respect to pole S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
